name: Indigo — Distant Thunder
prompt: Create a wide, seamless horizontally repeating parallax background for a 2D pixel-art artillery tank game. Indigo-violet dusk sky grading to warm dusty peach near the horizon; distant jagged mountain ranges at separate depths; wispy storm clouds; tiny distant ruined radio towers and a few silhouettes of wind-bent trees. Calm atmospheric backdrop that lets the actual foreground terrain and projectiles remain readable. Three separate landscape image layers with visible depth and different parallax factors. No tanks, no weapons, no people, no letters or UI. Mountains belong near the horizon with plenty of clear sky above. Cohesive restrained pixel-art palette, atmospheric aerial perspective.
styleTheme: Crisp cinematic pixel art, retro artillery landscape
